Emotional abuse is abuse. It is a violation & violence. It counts. Healing from it is much a part of any fight we partake in for women's rights. Let no one tell you differently. In Tarana Burke's own words, the goal of #MeToo  is also “to radicalize the notion of mass healing.”

"Somatic or bodily awareness allows us to create what is called a “window of tolerance” that we are not rooted in our past and thereby we are not the sum of our trauma."
